statement: let block := fun x : ℕ => Finset.Ioc x (2*x); let roots := fun a q : ℕ => (Finset.range q).filter (fun r => q ∣ r^2+a); (∀ (Q : ℕ) [NeZero Q] (χ : DirichletCharacter ℂ Q) (s : ℂ), 0 < s.re → s.re < 1 → DirichletCharacter.LFunction χ s = 0 → s.re = 1 / 2) → ∃ C : ℝ, 0<C ∧ ∀ a q x : ℕ, 0<q → Nat.Coprime a q → 2≤x → |(∑ n ∈ (block x).filter (fun n => q ∣ n^2+a), ArithmeticFunction.vonMangoldt n) - ((roots a q).card : ℝ)*x/(Nat.totient q : ℝ)| ≤ C*((roots a q).card : ℝ)*Real.sqrt x*Real.log (4*(q : ℝ)*x)^2

brief.en: Coprimality puts every root in a reduced class. Keep the root count in both main and error terms.
